source: Vaastav Fantasy-Premier-League historical cleaned_players.csv + current FPL snapshot
selection_notes: Top 30 is position-balanced to the legal FPL squad ratio: 4 GK, 10 DEF, 10 MID, 6 FWD.
Scores are position-relative percentiles, not official FPL projections.
Historical seasons are weighted toward more recent seasons when available.
The historical dataset's xP/ep fields are intentionally excluded from the analysis because its README warns about potential lookahead bias.
